title: Independent Potters Program
cost_text: $100 per month; clay $20 per 22 lb; firing tickets $1.50 each based on volume
how_to_join: Contact studio management to meet, complete orientation, demonstrate safe equipment use and skill
summary: Join experienced potters with an ongoing membership to use View's studio equipment during open hours, including a raku kiln and gas kiln. Requires orientation and demonstrated proficiency; suggest taking a class first.
source_quote: Independent potters are a valuable asset to View. Potters volunteer in our annual pottery events by making bowls and other vessels to be sold.
evidence_sentence: The Independent Potters program page lists a raku kiln and gas kiln among the studio's equipment available to members.
